messages:
Diego (PM): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — can product leads confirm timelines for API rate-limit tiers, Console per-route dashboards, and Optimize recommendations rollout? Trying to plan Q3/Q4 deliverables.
Samira (CTO): Short answer: API rate-limit tiers (soft launch internal) targeted mid-August; public rollout late Sept. Console per-route dashboards on track for Beta in Oct. Optimize recommendations (model/quantization suggestions) aim for preview in November. High level only — will post exact dates.
Alex Kim: For API rate limits: does 'tiers' mean new per-route quotas or account-level plans? Need to know for SDK changes.
Samira (CTO): It's both. Account plans + per-route overrides. SDK changes minimal — added header `x-rw-limit-tier` for telemetry. @Alex Kim we'll share the spec by EOD Friday.
Marie Chen: Console dashboards — will those include token-level cost breakdown? And retention window?
Priya (Eng Lead): Yes token-level costs, and per-route latency P50/P95. Retention default 90 days, opt-in 365 for enterprise. Some backend work with analytics pipeline; may impact GA date if pipeline delays.
Jordan (SRE): Any SLO changes from rate-limit tiers? We need the fallback policy for heavy customers.
Samira (CTO): Fallback policy: soft-deny -> degrade to smaller model variant -> 429 only when burst capacity exhausted. We'll publish runbook. @Jordan we'll sync offline.
Diego (PM): Optimize question — will it recommend quantization profiles automatically or just suggestions?
Priya (Eng Lead): Phase 1 = suggestions + cost/latency estimates. Phase 2 (early 2026) automates quantized deploys in Dedicated. Preview in Nov still manual apply.
Alex Kim: Are there public migration guides? we should coordinate SDK docs.
Marie Chen: Could we get a one-pager for customer-facing comms?
Samira (CTO): Yes — comms + changelog. @Diego can you draft the one-pager and we'll iterate?
Diego (PM): I can. Will draft by Tue.
release-bot: deploy notice — canary rollout for console analytics pipeline started 2024-08-02T19:20:00Z
Jordan (SRE): Small note — if analytics pipeline canary shows >5% error on event ingestion we'll pause.
Priya (Eng Lead): Adding canary config snippet:
```
canary:
  traffic: 10%
  duration: 72h
  criteria: ingestion_error_rate < 0.05
```
Samira (CTO): Copy. Also product OKRs updated to reflect these deliveries.
Diego (PM): Thanks. Any blockers from legal/compliance for Private deployment features tied to Optimize?
Marie Chen: Legal flagged KMS integration for automated quantization deploys — working through the checklist. Not blocking preview but will affect on-prem GA.
Alex Kim: Thanks all. If no objections, I'll update the SDK PR timeline with the spec once shared.
Samira (CTO): Thanks. We'll follow up in the product leadership sync tomorrow. :rocket:
